methods.description: Authored single-channel pressure waveform with reproducible windowed spectral density. No physical hydrophone, measured acoustic field or propagation model.
methods.waveform: t=sample/4096. Tone=0.002*(0.85+0.15*cos(2π*0.4*t))*sin(2π*224*t); harmonic=0.0007*sin(2π*448*t+0.4). For u=t−1 in[0,6], chirp=0.0015*sin(π*u/6)^2*sin(2π*(480*u+(640/12)*u²)), otherwise 0. Transient=0.003*exp(−0.5*((t−5.7)/0.07)^2)*sin(2π*1450*t). Background is deterministic 32-bit integer-hash noise scaled to±0.00012 Pa; executable formula in model.mjs. Pressure=float32(sum).
methods.transform: For each complete 512-sample window, remove arithmetic mean before applying periodic Hann w[n]=0.5−0.5cos(2πn/N). PSD=|DFT(w*(x−mean))|²/(fs*sum(w²)), doubling bins1..N/2−1 only. Retain float32 Pa²/Hz. No zero padding. Window starts advance 128 samples; no partial final window.
methods.availability: Pressure indices 12800..13823 and 25600..25855 are not retained. Sample mask 0 means unavailable and uses a zero pressure storage placeholder. Frame mask 1 only if all 512 inputs are retained, including zero-weight Hann endpoints. Missing frames store zero PSD placeholders. No interpolation, filling or physical-cause inference.
methods.timing: UTC origin is authored, not clock-traceable. Sample index i maps to i/4096 s. Window index f starts at f*128/4096 s; full-window center is(startSample+256)/4096 s. Last contributing sample=(startSample+511)/4096 s. Last recording sample 7.999755859375 s; nominal capture span 8 s.
methods.display: 10log10(PSD/1e−12) dB re 1 µPa²/Hz. Retained zero density is negative infinity, not unavailable. Viewer color clipping must not change the retained value. Density is not broadband SPL.
limits: Pressure values are authored, not a measured physical calibration
One channel; no bearing, range, beamforming or localization
No source identity inference or detector
No empirical hydrophone response, anti-alias filter, acoustic propagation or ambient-noise characterization
8 Hz bin spacing is not an independent physical frequency-resolution claim
Successful reproduction verifies numerical and source consistency only
